notes: GPU-time metering (not credits) with a two-speed system: metered Fast hours + free unlimited Relax queue. Headline prices unchanged 2024–2026 — rare price stability; the structural change was Video V1 (June 2025) consuming ~8x image GPU time. No free tier, no enterprise tier; revenue >$1M companies must buy Pro/Mega (ToS).

change_events.description: Video V1 launch: video jobs cost ~8x an image job in GPU time (reported figure — Holz statement); unlimited Relax video added to Pro/Mega. Headline plan prices unchanged — a capability-expansion that repriced effective usage.
change_events.user_reaction: Fast-hour burn complaints from video users
